verdict.rationale: Lambda documents programmatic instance launch through its live, key-gated Lambda Cloud REST API, which it says can "create and manage" resources, and bills ODC usage hourly in one-minute increments. Termination is only implied by a third-party tool that terminates instances. Support confirmed that running instances are billed whether idle or not, which is consistent with paying for what is running rather than contradicting it. Missing for 10: documented stop and restart operations, first-party documentation of the terminate endpoint, and explicit confirmation that stopped or terminated instances stop accruing charges.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start, stop, restart, and terminate instances programmatically and keep paying only for what is running

citations.quote: You can also launch instances programmatically by using the Lambda Cloud API.
The Lambda Cloud API provides a set of REST API endpoints you can use to create and manage your Lambda Cloud resources.
ODC prices instances by hourly usage and bills in one-minute increments.
